name: oberthci
description: Oberth CI for Claude Code: the MCP server of your own Oberth installation and the agent loop skill.

plugins.name: oberth
plugins.description: Install Oberth CI on your own cluster with /oberth:install (credentials go to a secrets file, never into the session), or connect Claude Code to an existing server over MCP (URL and token kept in Claude Code's credential store), trust its CA by an explicit SHA-256 pin with /oberth:connect, and follow the agent loop: one events_wait kept open, holds serviced within their TTL, assisted runs never taken as evidence.
